abstract: The present communication deals with the study of 388 tumours of the male urogenital tract diagnosed histopathologically during the period of 1984 to 1990. Of these 12 (3.09%) were benign and the rest 376 (96.91%) malignant. The incidence of malignant growths of male urogenital tract was 8.71% of all the malignancies or 14.19% of all cancers in males. Renal tumours constituted 10.64% of all the malignant tumours of male urogenital tract or 1.51% of all the male cancers. Morphological variants were renal cell carcinoma (37.5%), Wilms' tumour (47.5%), transitional cell carcinoma (7.5%), papillary cystic adenocarcinoma (3.5%), leiomyosarcoma (2.5%), metastatic from thyroid (2.5%). The mean age of the cases for renal cell carcinoma was 50.3 years and for Wilms' tumour 3.5 years. Urinary bladder cancer comprised 29.52% of all the malignancies of male urogenital tract or 4.19% of all malignant growths in males. The average age of the patients was 53.9 years. Transitional cell carcinoma was the commonest type of tumour (91.9%). Primary malignant tumours of the testis constituted 0.95% of all the malignancies, 1.55% of all male cancers, 10.9% of all malignancies of male urogenital tract or 18.3% of all the malignant growths of male genital tract. The mean age of the patients was 40.6 years. Seminoma was the commonest -46.34% of all the testicular tumours. The incidence of prostatic cancer was 1.81% of all cancers, 2.95% of all malignancies in males or 20.74% of all malignancies of male urogenital tract or 34.82% of malignancies of male genital tract.(ABSTRACT TRUNCATED AT 250 WORDS)
abstract_ja: 本報告は1984年から1990年の間に病理組織学的に診断された男性泌尿生殖器の腫瘍388例の検討である。このうち良性は12例(3.09%)、残り376例(96.91%)が悪性であった。男性泌尿生殖器の悪性腫瘍は男性の全悪性腫瘍の8.71%、男性の全癌の14.19%にあたった。腎腫瘍は男性泌尿生殖器悪性腫瘍の10.64%を占め、組織型は腎細胞癌(37.5%)、Wilms腫瘍(47.5%)、移行上皮癌(7.5%)、乳頭嚢胞性腺癌(3.5%)、平滑筋肉腫(2.5%)、甲状腺からの転移性腫瘍(2.5%)であった。腎細胞癌の平均年齢は50.3歳、Wilms腫瘍は3.5歳であった。膀胱癌は男性泌尿生殖器悪性腫瘍の29.52%、男性の全悪性腫瘍の4.19%を占め、平均年齢は53.9歳であった。移行上皮癌が最も多い腫瘍型(91.9%)であった。精巣の原発性悪性腫瘍は全悪性腫瘍の0.95%、男性の全癌の1.55%、男性泌尿生殖器悪性腫瘍の10.9%、男性生殖器の悪性腫瘍の18.3%を占めた。患者の平均年齢は40.6歳であった。精巣腫瘍の中ではセミノーマが最も多く(46.34%)であった。前立腺癌の頻度は全癌の1.81%、男性の全悪性腫瘍の2.95%、男性泌尿生殖器悪性腫瘍の20.74%、男性生殖器悪性腫瘍の34.82%であった。(要旨は250語で打ち切られている)
